show: Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang return with a brand new set, champagne, and pop culture…
kurzfassung: Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang debut a brand new studio set and celebrate with champagne while diving into pop culture. They discuss casting updates, memorable celebrity encounters, and their recent theme park adventures. The hosts also share thoughts on recent album releases and debate the current state of movie fandom.
stichpunkte: The hosts unveil their brand new production design and celebrate with champagne in the studio.
Bowen Yang discusses his upcoming role in 'Oh Mary!' and working with his acting coach.
The duo shares stories about running into Rosie O'Donnell in New York City.
Recapping a trip to Disney World, including a memorable safari tour with a guide named Angel.
A detailed discussion on recent pop music releases, highlighting Ariana Grande and Lady Gaga.
Debating the current state of cinephilia and the modern movie-going experience.

kapitel.titel: Disney World and Animal Kingdom Safari

clips.hook: An award-winning podcast finally gets an identity
clips.text: Ryan Weiss introduces his daily audio-video podcast, drawing on a decade and a half of experience as a spiritual guide and emotional intelligence coach.

clips.hook: The fear of God and leaked casting news
clips.text: The hosts celebrate three decades of Mariah Carey's album Daydream while receiving champagne from a handsome server.

clips.hook: Stumping the runway on a Disney safari
clips.text: An eventful evening in Soho around 6:15 PM involved a fall on the sidewalk that required multiple attempts to stand back up.
A visit to Disney's Animal Kingdom included riding the Kilimanjaro Safaris for the first time in a long period while waiting to experience Flight of Passage.

clips.hook: Everything in modern culture is just fine
clips.text: The group discusses bad vibes regarding social plans and a shared ambition to adopt the mentality of Lisa Rinna during her initial season on television.

beschreibung:
Finally, Las Culturistas has a SET... and it has SET... them free. It's a brand new Las Cultch as Matt + Bowen neurally link and ride to the beach, to the stars and to heaven in this long-awaited culture catchup! Bowen discusses taking on the role of Mary Todd Lincoln (!!!) in OH, MARY (or shall we say BO, MARY!?) on Broadway (9/15 - 12/6!!!) and being ridden like a Banshee by a Navi acting coach. The boys discuss the albums of the moment: Confessions II, petal and, of course, C, XOXO, and confront themselves about why they haven't seen The Odyssey. Also, how Zara Larsson could be Jimmy Buffett if she wants, what it feels like to recover from a panic attack just in time for the Hilary Duff concert, and meeting Rosie O'Donnell in the wild... on Broadway! All this, Abdul El Sayed's "Positions" energy, the regional pronunciation of the word "Michigander", and "face acting" in film. All this, a shout out to Disney Cast Member Angel from the Kilimanjaro Safari in Animal Kingdom (we will literally never forget you), a highly awaited discourse on Peacock's SMASH HIT The Five Star Weekend (!!!), and due respect paid to The QVC Woman aka Toni Brattin, who we will hold on to forever. Real Miami girls get it poppin ❤️
See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
